map.为什么重了失速速度更高？: Why Does a Heavier Aircraft Stall Faster?
map.要保持 L=W，重量大需更大速度（或更大 C_L）。故满载比空载更易在低速失速，: L=W must hold, so a heavier weight needs a higher speed (or a larger C_L). Hence a fully loaded aircraft stalls at a lower speed than an empty one, and for takeoff and landing compute Vs at the maximum landing weight and leave a margin.
map.影响。高空密度低，同重量下需更高真速才能产生同等升力，故失速真速随高度上升；但指: It matters. Air density is lower at altitude, so at the same weight a higher true airspeed is needed for the same lift, and the true stall speed rises with altitude; but the indicated airspeed (IAS) stall speed is basically unchanged because IAS is proportional to dynamic pressure.
